title: Israel's Only Savior

questions.question: But now thus says the LORD, he who created you, O Jacob, he who formed you, O Israel: "Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:1 (ESV): "I have called you by name,"

questions.question: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:2 (ESV): "and through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm you;"

questions.question: When you walk through fire you shall not be burned, and the flame shall not what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:2 (ESV): "and the flame shall not consume you."

questions.question: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:3 (ESV): "the Holy One of Israel, your Savior."

questions.question: I, I am the LORD, and besides me there is no what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:11 (ESV): "and besides me there is no savior."

questions.question: Because you are precious in my eyes, and honored, and I love you, I give men in return for you, peoples in exchange for your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:4 (ESV): "peoples in exchange for your life."

questions.question: I will bring your offspring from the east, and from the west I will what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:5 (ESV): "and from the west I will gather you."

questions.question: Bring out the people who are blind, yet have eyes, who are deaf, yet have what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:8 (ESV): "who are deaf, yet have ears!"

questions.question: "You are my witnesses," declares the LORD, "and my servant whom I have chosen, that you may know and believe me and understand that I am what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:10 (ESV): "and understand that I am he."

questions.question: Thus says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: "For your sake I send to Babylon and bring them all down as what?"
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:14 (ESV): "bring them all down as fugitives,"

questions.question: Remember not the former things, nor consider the things of old. Behold, I am doing a what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:18-19 (ESV): "Behold, I am doing a new thing;"

questions.question: I give water in the wilderness, rivers in the desert, to give drink to my chosen people, the people whom I formed for myself that they might declare my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:21 (ESV): "that they might declare my praise."

questions.question: You have not bought me sweet cane with money, or satisfied me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened me with your sins; you have wearied me with your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:24 (ESV): "you have wearied me with your iniquities."

questions.question: I, I am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake, and I will not remember your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:25 (ESV): "and I will not remember your sins."

questions.question: Your first father sinned, and your mediators transgressed against me. Therefore I will profane the princes of the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 43:28 (ESV): "Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary,"

key_verse_text: Fear not, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by name, you are mine. When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm you.
